envelope.description: Exclude the record's own artifact paths from BOTH derivations

body.title: Exclude the record's own artifact paths from BOTH derivations
body.summary: Apply the exclusion list to the working-tree derivation AND the range derivation, and have the writers pass the record's own json and md paths. Deliberately separate from the range work because it fixes a defect that exists independently of which range is used: today the only dirty paths when the collector runs are the record's own files, so the change set is not merely empty but actively WRONG — it claims the Story changed BUILD.md. Keeping it its own task means a rollback of the range change cannot reintroduce it.
acceptanceChecks: The exclusion is asserted SEPARATELY for the working-tree derivation and for the range derivation — an exclusion applied to only one is the bug half-fixed and must fail the suite
Only the record's OWN two paths are excluded; other artifacts under .insrc/artifacts and docs/ remain in the change set when the Story genuinely touched them
A test reproduces the exact observed state — the record's json and md dirty in the working tree — and asserts the derived change set contains neither
A Story that genuinely changed ONLY artifact files still yields a non-empty change set, proving the exclusion is path-specific rather than a blanket artifact filter

tests.name: the exclusion applies to the WORKING-TREE derivation — asserted on its own, because an exclusion on only one derivation is the bug half-fixed
the exclusion applies to the RANGE derivation — asserted separately from the working-tree case
ONLY the record's own two paths are excluded; other .insrc/artifacts and docs/ files survive in the change set
the record's own json and md are DIRTY in a real repo and still excluded — the exact state that produced the observed wrong change set
a Story whose commits touch ONLY artifact paths still yields a non-empty change set (docs-only edge case), proving the filter is path-specific
